component: Reduced motion for the first-screen screening room (src/screening/sequence.js, filmShader.js, curtain.js)
reason: With reduced motion the film stays black and white with still grain, but there is no flicker, gate weave, 12 fps stutter, frame slip or 3D pop-out, and the curtain fades in 0.6 s instead of sweeping. It follows the setting if it changes during the visit. Nothing is drawn off screen or in a hidden tab.

component: Screening room states and controls (projector button, Pause, Mute, status line)
reason: The projector itself is the button; its name follows the show (Play / Pause / Resume the screening) and the status line says each step in words, including when a press is ignored. Pause and Mute show their state with aria-pressed and a square mark, never by colour alone. Without WebGL the film plays in a plain video with a visible button.
